**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 28 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 26 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 23 [Blade Mercenary](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2551) **Source** [Pathfinder #190: The Choosing](/Sources.aspx?ID=198) pg. 52 **Perception** +15 **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +17, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +20, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +16, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +17, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +17 **Str** +3 **Dex** +2 **Con** +4 **Int** +0 **Wis** +2 **Cha** +3 **Items** steel-colored [_bird feather token_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=244), _+1 [chainmail](/Armor.aspx?ID=9)_, _+1 [composite longbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=74)_ (20 arrows), _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=31)_, [Signal Whistle](/Equipment.aspx?ID=50), [Steel Shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=3) (Hardness 5, 20 HP, BT 10) --- **AC** 27 **Fort** +19 **Ref** +15 **Will** +17 **HP** 165 **Bravery** When the mercenary rolls a successful Will save against a [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68) effect, they get a critical success instead. When the mercenary gains the [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) condition, reduce its value by 1.
**[Attack of Opportunity](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=3)**
**[Shield Block](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=32)** --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** _longsword_ +19 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)), **Damage** 2d8+9 slashing **Ranged** _longbow_ +18 ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=191), [range increment 100 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 0](/Traits.aspx?ID=254), [volley 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=201)), **Damage** 2d8+9 piercing **Cat Fall** The mercenary treats falls as 25 feet shorter. **Power Attack** The mercenary makes a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating the mercenary's multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, the mercenary deals an extra die of weapon damage. **Ready Armaments** The mercenary Interacts to draw or stow a weapon, then Interacts to draw or stow a weapon. The mercenary can instead [Raise a Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98) instead of either Interact action.
name: Blade Mercenary
